units.source_text: 但是，看上去她那种对城市事物的憧憬，现在已隐藏在纯朴的绝望之中，变成一种天真的梦想。

en.t: But her yearning for things of the city seemed now to be hidden inside a simple despair, transformed into an innocent dream.

units.source_text: 他强烈地感到：她这种情感与其说带有城市败北者的那种傲慢的不满，不如说是一种单纯的徒劳。

en.t: He felt strongly that this feeling of hers was not so much the arrogant discontent of someone defeated by the city as a simple futility.

units.source_text: 她自己没有显露出落寞的样子，然而在岛村的眼里，却成了难以想象的哀愁。

en.t: She herself showed no sign of loneliness, yet in Shimamura's eyes it became an unimaginable sorrow.

units.source_text: 如果一味沉溺在这种思绪里，连岛村自己恐怕也要陷入缥缈的感伤之中，以为生存本身就是一种徒劳。

en.t: If he let himself sink completely into such thoughts, Shimamura himself would probably fall into a vague sentimentality and come to think that life itself was futile.

units.source_text: 但是，山中的冷空气，把眼前这个女子脸上的红晕浸染得更加艳丽了。

en.t: But the cold mountain air had stained the flush on the face of the woman before him even more vividly.
